title: StoreAndForwardPolicy v1 — store-and-forward discipline as data: a task queued for a sleeping node waits at most default_ttl_seconds unless its queueing names a ttl_seconds of its own, and no task ever waits past max_ttl_seconds; the fabric holds at most max_held_tasks tasks in total, at most max_held_per_recipient for one sleeping node, and at most max_held_per_sender from one sender; expiry is always an event with a notice to the sender (expiry_evented is always true) and a held task is delivered exactly once (deliver_once is always true) — a policy naming weaker discipline fails validation (Y-061)
